citation.authors: Gold MH, McGuire M, Mustoe TA, Pusic A et al

record.design: Updated clinical recommendations from literature review and consensus on scar management
record.finding: A combination of multiple treatments gives the best chance of success for hypertrophic scars and keloids. The panel advocates earlier, more aggressive initial management of keloids, including earlier 5-fluorouracil.
record.note: Expert consensus plus literature; not specific to Black skin.
